measurement: Sequential 4-tug control-cycle latency on common online teacher-generated states
student_pipeline: 4 actor feature/forward + local progress/approach filters; weights loaded once
teacher_pipeline: 4 individually optimized NMPC controllers; warm started, maxiter=6
included: Policy calculation and local preprocessing, excludes environment integration/disk I/O, excludes weight loading
limitations: Only early approach states (first roughly 210s); timings depend on hardware, Python, solver, library versions, warm starts. Not a full mission latency guarantee and not a closed-loop outcome comparison.
